verdict.rationale: Decagon's own marketing describes brand-voice behavior across its channels: chat, email and voice are "on-brand", voice is "multilingual" and "customized to your brand", Experiments covers "refining tone", and Simulations tests check that agents "reflect your brand". All of this is vendor-claimed, and there is no documented control a support leader uses to set tone or voice, and nothing showing consistency across topics and languages. Missing for 10: documented tone/brand-voice configuration controls, evidence of voice consistency across languages and topics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I control the agent's tone and brand voice, and it stays consistent across topics and languages
